slots.name: after-party count
slots.sentence: Arjun Shah, who goes by DJ AJ, is one of the most popular artists on the Indian wedding circuit and has played more than 150 such Boiler Room-themed after-parties since last March — from weddings in Mumbai to Cairo, with the Pyramids of Giza in the background.
